notes.title: The show !
notes.content:
Hello, February 27 will be the first in-game event.


We do not tell you the content of the event to keep the surprise;)


Here's how to participate in the event:

- Log in to the game before 19:00 (GMT).

- From 18:55 (GMT), the "EVENT" game mode will be available (You just have to click on PLAY).

- If you are in a game, it will automatically teleport you to the event.


Appointment on February 27 at 19:00 (GMT) to attend the event :)

notes.title: Update Details v.002
notes.content:
Before telling you about the show, here are the new features of the v.002 update :


- New Menu
- New Outfit
- First temporary game mode (One Door)
- New menu settings (To modify the sounds)
- Bugs Fixes


And more...



Finally, get ready for the show on February 27th.

We can not tell you more at the moment (See you in a few days for more information)
